description: Business letter in the hand of Avraham b. Shelomo (son of the Gaʾon) to an unidentified addressee. The sender provides an update about money owed to the addressee; mentions Raʾs al-Seder; previous letters sent to Tinnīs; an order for an unidentified item described in some detail (ll. 9–13); an order for a large vessel (? rajūja) for water if the addressee goes down to Tinnīs; and Abū Saʿd.
description_he: מכתב מאברהם בן הגאון לשותף עסקי בפוסטאט.
